reason: An appearance customization plugin for DeepSeek Harness that provides built-in themes, local wallpaper processing, light and dark color schemes, transparency and blur controls, and persistent appearance settings.

summaries.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供多套内置主题、本地壁纸处理、明暗配色以及透明度和模糊控制的外观定制插件。
summaries.en: An appearance customization plugin for DeepSeek Harness offering built-in themes, local wallpaper processing, light and dark palettes, and transparency and blur controls.

capabilities: customizes application themes and interface styling
allows local background image selection and client-side compression
extracts colors from selected images for generated light and dark palettes
